Cut 1 Prompt — “어떨까, 넌” Watercolor Album Cover

## 1) Image Style and Mood

A square contemporary Korean indie-pop album cover blending an ultra-realistic beauty portrait with delicate watercolor artwork.

The image feels quiet, poetic, dreamy, and emotionally restrained, as though the memory of one person has softly appeared on a sheet of paper.

Use a clean digital editorial finish with subtle handmade watercolor texture. Do not apply any film stock reference, analog film grain, vintage film coloration, light leaks, or cinematic film emulation.

The overall mood is wistful, intimate, and contemplative rather than bright, cute, cheerful, or dramatically sad.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

Arin’s side-profile portrait quietly emerges from a wide bloom of pink watercolor.

She should not look like a conventional model posing for a beauty photograph. She appears more like a half-remembered person slowly returning to someone’s thoughts.

Her facial features remain recognizable and realistically rendered, while her neck, shoulders, clothing, and outer silhouette gradually dissolve into the white paper and translucent watercolor.

The portrait exists between a real person and a painted silhouette, preserving Arin’s identity while maintaining the symbolic simplicity of an emotional album cover.

## 3) Location, Format, and Environment

A minimal abstract album-art environment rather than a physical location.

Square 1:1 composition.

The base is clean white or softly warm ivory watercolor paper with a subtle natural paper texture.

There is no room, landscape, furniture, architecture, or realistic background.

The visual world consists only of:

- Arin’s profile portrait
- Organic pink watercolor washes
- Generous white negative space
- The exact handwritten Korean title “어떨까, 넌”
- A small subtle watermark

## 4) Background and Graphic Elements

Across the central portion of the paper, create a broad organic watercolor bloom made from layered raspberry pink, muted magenta, blush pink, dusty rose, and softly diluted burgundy.

The watercolor should appear absorbed naturally into paper, with irregular feathered edges, translucent overlaps, soft pigment pooling, and gentle variations in saturation.

Keep the watercolor expressive but uncluttered.

A very small amount of delicate pigment particles or faint luminous specks may appear inside the wash, only enough to add a quiet dreamlike feeling.

Do not add flowers, decorative frames, furniture, jewelry, abstract symbols, logos, music notes, stars, hearts, or unrelated props.

## 5) Camera Composition and Layout

Place Arin in the center-right or right side of the square frame.

Show her in a bust-length left-facing side profile.

Her face, jawline, short bob haircut, neck, and upper shoulder line remain clearly visible, while the lower bust and shoulder edges softly fade into the ivory paper and pink watercolor.

Her face should occupy enough space to remain identifiable but should not dominate the entire cover.

Leave broad, intentional negative space on the left side, directly in the direction of her gaze.

Place the title “어떨까, 넌” within this left-side negative space, slightly away from the exact center.

The title must not overlap her eyes, nose, lips, jawline, or the central facial silhouette.

Maintain a refined visual balance between the portrait, watercolor, title, and empty paper.

Avoid a crowded poster layout, symmetrical commercial advertising composition, or oversized typography.

## 6) Model Expression — Arin

Arin is a beautiful young Korean woman with a small V-line face, clear fair skin, large almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, a straight high nose bridge, and soft pink lips.

She has a trendy dark-brown short bob haircut, between chin and collarbone length, styled with soft inward C-curls and light see-through bangs.

Her appearance is modern, clean, elegant, and sophisticated, with refined contemporary K-pop beauty.

### Pose and Gaze

Arin is shown in a calm left-facing side profile or very slight semi-profile.

She looks toward a distant point in the empty space, slightly downward or straight ahead.

She must not look directly at the camera.

Her chin is lifted only slightly so that the jawline and neck remain graceful and natural.

Her shoulders are lowered and relaxed.

No dramatic gestures are needed, and her hands do not need to appear.

One or two fine strands of hair may fall naturally beside her cheek.

### Expression

A quiet, emotionally contained expression.

Her lips are softly relaxed, neither smiling nor visibly sorrowful.

Her gaze suggests longing, curiosity, and a private memory she has not spoken aloud.

Avoid crying, exaggerated melancholy, a broad smile, seductive expressions, or theatrical emotion.

### Wardrobe

A minimal white, ivory, or extremely pale blush-pink top.

Use a lightweight soft material such as matte silk, fine chiffon, or smooth soft cotton.

The design is simple and undecorated, with no prints, lace, ruffles, buttons, jewelry, logos, or strong fashion details.

The clothing should gently disappear into the pale paper beneath her shoulders.

### Makeup

Fresh contemporary K-beauty makeup with a thin, clean, semi-glowing complexion.

Natural luminous skin with visible realistic texture.

Soft rose-beige and muted pink shading around the eyes.

Naturally defined eyelashes without heavy eyeliner.

A light diffused blush spread softly across the cheeks.

Moist rose-pink or subtle MLBB lips with a translucent finish.

The makeup should feel pure, refined, and emotional rather than sharp, glamorous, or heavily styled.

## 7) Lighting, Color, and Atmosphere

Use soft, even diffused lighting with a gentle front-side or diagonal side light.

Arin’s profile must remain readable, including her eye shape, nose bridge, lips, jawline, and skin texture.

Keep shadows very soft and restrained so the portrait visually connects with the flat watercolor surface.

Avoid dramatic chiaroscuro, strong rim light, hard shadows, clipped highlights, glossy commercial studio lighting, or strong three-dimensional sculpting.

Main palette:

- Raspberry pink
- Muted magenta
- Blush pink
- Dusty rose
- Soft burgundy
- White
- Warm ivory

Maintain Arin’s natural, clean skin tone.

The pink should feel lyrical and emotionally expressive rather than fluorescent, candy-colored, childish, or excessively romantic.

## 8) Typography and Key Direction

Render only the exact Korean title:

“어떨까, 넌”

Use a delicate, naturally flowing handwritten Korean calligraphy style.

The lettering should feel personal and emotional, as though written gently by hand with a brush pen.

Use deep muted purple, dark plum, or restrained burgundy ink.

Keep the original phrase clearly legible and preserve the comma exactly.

Place it in the negative space toward which Arin is looking.

Do not add the artist name, album information, English translation, upper caption, lower caption, central logo, the word “치즈,” or any additional Korean or English text.

Do not place the title directly over Arin’s face.

The final image should feel like a poetic memory preserved on watercolor paper: Arin’s real profile remains visible, while her body and silhouette gently dissolve into pink pigment and white emptiness.

## 9) Watermark

Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner of the image.

Use Helvetica Neue font, thin or light weight.

The watermark should be white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal, and softly blended into the artwork.

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette
Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 final vacation portrait photographed on Fujifilm Pro 400H 120 medium-format color-negative film.

Fujifilm Pro 400H must define the frame through airy pastel separation, cool mint atmosphere, luminous neutral Korean skin, softly open shadows, delicate organic grain, creamy white architecture, smooth highlight rolloff, restrained summer color, gently softened analog edge acuity and quiet pastel density variation. Keep the pastel-mint clothing cool and fresh without shifting Arin’s skin toward green or cyan. The frame must feel like an ongoing vacation moment rather than a staged farewell pose or campaign finale.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story
After the small gelato mishap, Arin rests against the cream-white wall beside the stand. A dog passes outside the frame and catches her attention. She turns her gaze toward it while keeping the gelato cone upright.

Narrative anchor: Arin watches the passing dog because the vacation is not ending with a dramatic final pose; it simply continues through another small distraction.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment
Exterior wall beside a lakeside gelato stand at Cospudener See, midsummer, approximately 3:30–4:30 p.m. Bright summer sunlight, soft open shade beneath or beside the awning, cream-white wall, pastel mint-and-yellow storefront elements, warm air and irregular pavement. The dog or walker may remain entirely outside the frame. No identifiable background faces.

## 4) Background and Props
Foreground: a softly blurred awning edge or storefront detail that never covers Arin.
Midground: Arin leaning lightly against the wall in a pastel-mint terry outfit while holding the cone upright.
Background: cream-white textured wall, softly blurred pastel storefront details, indistinct menu board and broad empty space in the direction of her gaze.

The gelato retains an irregular raspberry-red and mango-yellow double scoop with partially melted edges, realistic remaining volume, an upright waffle cone and ivory napkin. It must not appear perfectly restored like a product photograph.

## 5) Camera, Composition, Pose and Hands
Use a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, f/4. Full-body frame from approximately 70–80° side angle. Position Arin on one side and leave generous negative space in the direction of her gaze. Keep wall lines vertical and storefront perspective natural. Avoid extreme low angle or elongated legs.

Arin looks outside the frame toward a passing dog or walker and does not look at the camera.

Only one shoulder blade and shoulder lightly contact the wall; do not flatten the entire back against it. Bend the wall-side knee approximately 45°. Let the heel or outer edge of the wall-side foot lightly touch the wall while the opposite leg supports body weight. Keep hips neutral without exaggerated sideways projection. The gelato-holding arm rests comfortably in front of the body.

Her right hand holds the cone almost vertically. Thumb, index finger and middle finger maintain a stable grip through the napkin, while ring finger and little finger remain naturally bent and separated. Her left hand hangs comfortably beside the body: left hand relaxed, fingers naturally separated, wrist aligned. Keep the cone stable so melted gelato does not flow onto the clothing.

## 6) Model Expression
Arin is a beautiful adult Korean woman with a small refined V-line face, clear luminous neutral-ivory skin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, natural double eyelids, straight high nose bridge, soft pink lips and a trendy dark-brown chin-to-collarbone bob with loosened inward C-curls and light see-through bangs. She has a slim healthy figure, long balanced legs and realistic Korean proportions.

Skin: restrained retouching, subtle tonal variation, delicate natural texture, visible fine pores and thin natural luminosity.

Wardrobe: pastel-mint terry short-sleeve collared shirt and matching high-waisted shorts with relaxed resort fit, visible fine terry loops, realistic wall-contact compression at one shoulder and natural wrinkles at the waist, hip and bent knee. Add ivory low-top sneakers or simple sandals.

Hair: C-curl loosened by a full day of wind and humidity, with one end lightly touching the jaw or neck and small irregular flyaways. No freshly restyled final-shot hair.

Makeup: light transparent glow base, peach-pink watercolor blush, almost no visible eyeliner, defined natural lashes and transparent coral-pink glossy lips.

Expression: eyelids and brows relaxed, eyes showing comfortable curiosity toward the passing subject and lips naturally closed or forming a very small unplanned smile.

## 7) Lighting, Color and Atmosphere
Use strong afternoon sunlight diffused by the awning and bright storefront wall. Primary light enters from camera-left upper side, with soft even open shade across the face. Add rim light to bob ends, outer jaw, shoulder and terry sleeve, and neutral bounce from the cream wall and bright ground. Keep mint reflection away from the jaw and neck. Show gelato moisture without plastic shine and preserve the wall as cream ivory rather than clipped pure white.

## 8) Essential Direction and Physical Anchors
Preserve a physically stable upright cone, light one-shoulder wall contact rather than the full back pressed flat and an off-frame gaze with generous negative space in the direction of attention.

Physical consistency: realistic terry-cloth weight, visible towel-loop texture, wall-contact compression, stable cone grip, natural bent-knee balance, accurate foot-to-wall contact, correct contact shadows, coherent storefront perspective, progressive optical depth and neutral hip position.

## 9) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner using white semi-transparent Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, softly blended into the photograph.

## 10) Negative Prompt
Fixed negative prompt: plastic skin, beauty-filter face, malformed hands, fused or extra fingers, oversized eyes, clipped highlights, artificial HDR, CGI rendering, over-sharpening.

Set-specific negative prompt: full back unnaturally flattened against the wall, unstable tilted cone, gelato dripping upward or onto clothing, exaggerated hip pose, dog blocking the foreground, green or cyan skin contamination, dramatic farewell pose.

# Single-Cut Prompt — Where You Became Winter

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette

Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 cinematic winter photograph captured on **Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm motion-picture film, exposed around EI 400**.

The image must feel like a restrained narrative film still rather than a fashion campaign, fantasy illustration or dramatic memorial portrait.

Kodak Vision3 500T must define the frame through:

* cold blue open shadows

* softly compressed luminous highlights
* deep but readable forest-green blacks
* muted winter color separation
* fine organic cinematic grain
* subtle analog density variation
* smooth highlight rolloff
* restrained micro-contrast
* slightly softened optical edges
* low-saturation Korean skin with gentle residual warmth

Build the overall palette from deep blue-gray, muted charcoal, dark frozen-water blue and blackened forest green.

Allow a thin trace of pale amber-gold only where the first sunrise reaches the edges of Jieun’s hair, coat and the snow-covered landscape.

The **single red camellia must be the only clearly saturated color in the image**.

Its red should not feel decorative, romantic or luxurious. It should quietly hold several meanings at once: blood, memory, life, sacrifice and inherited love.

Preserve readable shadow detail in:

* the worn wool fibers of the coat
* the folds around the bent arms
* the frozen river surface
* the narrow exposed water channel
* the dark soil beneath disturbed snow
* the irregular silhouettes of distant trees

Do not crush the coat or forest into featureless black.

---

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

Jieun has come alone to the frozen riverside where her father was last seen.

This is the first winter after his death.

There is no gravestone, memorial plaque or written name in the landscape. The location is an ordinary and lonely natural place, holding only the invisible memory of someone’s final moments.

Jieun wears her father’s old forest-green wool coat.

The coat is more than one size too large for her, with lowered shoulder seams, long sleeves and a heavy structure that does not naturally belong to her smaller frame.

Between frozen soil and uneven snow, she notices one small red camellia blooming in unnatural silence.

She lowers herself onto one knee before it.

She does not pick the flower.

She does not touch its petals.

Her right fingertips stop several centimeters away, as though respecting the boundary between a living memory and something that must remain where it grew.

Her left hand holds the heavy coat collar close to her chest, not to create a fashionable pose, but to block the cold and feel the physical weight of the person who once wore it.

### Narrative Anchor

Jieun finally understands, through the flower, that someone became winter in her place so that she could remain alive.

This is not the moment when grief begins.

She has already cried for a long time.

This is the first moment when she looks beyond her father’s death and begins to see the life he left for her.

The frame must simultaneously contain:

* a sacrifice that has already ended
* a loss that still remains
* an understanding that has only just begun
* the smallest internal decision to continue living

The emotional realization is:

**“I was not abandoned. I was someone he protected until the very end.”**

---

## 3) Location, Season, Time and Environment

Set the scene on a gently sloping, completely deserted winter riverbank.

The river is mostly frozen, but a narrow black channel of exposed water remains visible near its center.

Surround the area with:

* leafless birch trees
* irregular clusters of low dried reeds
* partially exposed dark soil
* broken winter stems
* shallow frozen depressions
* uneven wind-shaped snow

The environment must not resemble a battlefield, cemetery, fantasy realm or ceremonial memorial site.

It should feel like an ordinary landscape that has quietly absorbed someone’s last memory.

### Season

**Midwinter.**

The snow fell approximately one day earlier.

It is not pristine.

Show:

* areas that partially melted and refroze
* thin translucent ice crusts
* dark soil exposed by wind
* broken dry vegetation
* three or four softened footprints
* a compacted oval depression where Jieun’s knee presses into the snow
* wet snow and soil clinging lightly to her boot sole

### Time

Capture the brief transition from the final minutes before sunrise to the moment when the sun has just crossed the horizon.

The sky remains predominantly cold blue-gray.

Only a narrow band of restrained amber-gold appears near the distant horizon.

Cold night and the beginning of morning must coexist in the same frame.

### Wind and Atmospheric Movement

A weak intermittent gust moves through the scene.

The wind must affect only:

* three or four thin strands beside Jieun’s face
* the loose edge of the oversized coat
* the tips of dried reeds
* a very small number of loose red petals
* sparse snow particles at different depths

Do not create dramatic flying hair or a strong snowstorm.

The few loose petals are not actively exploding from the living camellia.

They appear to have already been scattered nearby, like small fragments of an older memory.

All moving elements must follow one coherent wind direction.

## 4) Background Layers and Props

* one folded petal edge

### Background

The background should not explain a specific geographic location.

### Prop 1 — Her Father’s Coat

Jieun wears an old oversized wool coat in deep forest green.

### Camera Position

Do not use:

### Framing

Leave approximately 25% of the frame height as open space above Jieun’s head.

Position Jieun near the lower-right third rather than at the exact center.

Her face, right fingertips and the upper structure of the camellia must remain emotionally legible within a moderately shallow depth of field.

The flower may be fractionally softer than her eye, but its uneven petals and trapped snow crystals must still be recognizable.

## 6) Model Pose, Gaze and Hand Contact

### Gaze

**Jieun does not look at the camera.**

* thumb rests naturally beside the palm

The gesture must feel hesitant and reverent rather than magical, romantic or theatrical.

### Left Hand

Place the left hand slightly below the center of her chest, holding the thick coat collar.

Hand structure:

* anatomically accurate and realistic proportions

# 2026 K-FUSION HISTORICAL FANTASY ROMANCE EDITORIAL
# 지은(Jieun) × 심청전 — THE STILL WATER REMEMBERED HER
# SET 01 — SERENE DAYS BESIDE FATHER / 아버지 곁의 평온한 날들
# CUT 04 — DIGNITY IN THE LAST SUNLIGHT / 저녁빛 속에서 드러난 얼굴
# Model: Jieun / Shooting Date: 2026.08.12
# Vertical 3:4 / Person-Reference Image Mode / Jieun solo only
# Editorial Direction: K-Fusion Historical Romance × Golden-Hour Hanok Fashion Editorial × Quiet Nobility × Low-Saturation Korean Beauty × Subtle Foreshadowing Portrait
# Primary Emotional Medium: Jieun’s second exact direct gaze, relaxed full-body stance, low golden rim light, simple wildflowers and a quiet increase in presence
# Core Motif: broad hanok yard, pale-jade jeogori, ivory chima, small wildflowers, long evening shadow, braid and muted dark-red daenggi
# Emotional Direction: quiet confidence and innate dignity; a brief visual premonition of the future Crown Princess without making her royal in the present

## 0) Reference Facial Identity and Target Hair
The attached reference image is the sole facial identity source. Preserve Jieun’s exact adult face, proportions, eyes, brows, nose, lips, cheek volume, jawline, skin tone, asymmetry and identity cues.

TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE MODE — MANDATORY: use the established SET 01 soft-center-part low half-up hairstyle continuing into one loose mid-back Korean braid with a small muted dark-red daenggi, restrained crown volume and only one or two fine temple wisps. Remove any conflicting reference hair.

## 1) Scene
Place Jieun in the broad hanok courtyard near late golden hour. Use low walls, a restrained garden edge, warm wooden buildings and open sky only as supporting environmental layers. She holds a very small handful of ordinary field flowers in one hand. The flowers should feel casually gathered rather than styled as a bouquet.

## 2) Camera and Composition
Vertical 3:4. Full-body editorial portrait. Full-frame 70mm lens, f/3.5–f/4. Use a very mild low angle of approximately 5 degrees, enough to add presence but not monarchy or heroism. Jieun occupies 60–70% of frame height. Keep the courtyard layered and readable rather than empty.

## 3) Pose
Jieun stands with one foot fractionally forward and weight distributed naturally. Torso is mostly frontal with only a slight three-quarter turn. One hand holds the small flowers low beside the body; the opposite hand rests naturally near a chima fold. Shoulders relaxed, spine upright, hands anatomically complete. No formal court pose.

## 4) Gaze and Expression
DIRECT CAMERA EYE CONTACT. This is SET 01’s second direct gaze. Jieun meets the lens calmly and confidently. Compared with CUT 01, her presence is slightly stronger and more defined, but still gentle. Use a nearly neutral mouth with the faintest restrained warmth. No regal command, no broad smile, no sadness.

## 5) Costume and Silhouette
Use the same low-saturation pale-jade Korean silk jeogori with clean white dongjeong and restrained goreum, and warm-ivory/pale-oat ramie chima with generous traditional volume. Maintain naturally fuller feminine bust through realistic drape and soft roundness beneath the closed garment. No cleavage or modern fitted shaping. Keep the jeogori entirely outside and independent from the chima. The skirt folds fall with natural weight and create long vertical lines.

## 6) Makeup and Skin
Use semi-matte Cloud Skin with natural pores, delicate vellus hair and realistic cheek texture. Fine individual lashes, minimal warm-neutral lash-line definition, diluted peach-coral cheek and peach-beige coral blurred lip. Keep the face anatomically unchanged.

## 7) Light and Film
Use low golden-hour side/back light creating a soft warm rim along hair, shoulder and selected skirt folds. The face remains correctly exposed through open-sky and hanji-like courtyard bounce. Long evening shadows cross the ground naturally. Captured digitally and graded to evoke Kodak Portra 400: gentle warm skin, muted color, subtle grain, soft highlight rolloff and lifted but believable shadows.

## 8) Essential Direction
The image should hint at future royal dignity without any royal clothing, jewelry or setting. The source of the feeling is Jieun’s posture and gaze. Maintain full reference identity, modest natural bust volume and correct Korean garment separation.

## 9) Watermark
Add “ⓒyulim_mood” bottom-right, Helvetica Neue thin/light, small, white and semi-transparent.

## 10) Negative Prompt

cuts.title: 늘 비워두었던 아버지의 자리 / THE PLACE SHE ALWAYS SAVED FOR HIM
cuts.prompt:
# 2026 K-FUSION HISTORICAL FANTASY ROMANCE EDITORIAL
# 지은(Jieun) × 심청전 — THE STILL WATER REMEMBERED HER
# SET 01 — SERENE DAYS BESIDE FATHER / 아버지 곁의 평온한 날들
# CUT 05 — THE PLACE SHE ALWAYS SAVED FOR HIM / 늘 비워두었던 아버지의 자리
# Model: Jieun / Shooting Date: 2026.08.12
# Vertical 3:4 / Person-Reference Image Mode / Jieun solo only / Father implied but not depicted
# Editorial Direction: K-Fusion Historical Romance × Intimate Hanok Evening Editorial × Quiet Domestic Affection × Amber Afterglow × Poetic Relationship Portraiture
# Primary Emotional Medium: Jieun’s off-camera gaze, a small evening meal, a deliberately empty seat, a weathered white cane and the warmth of ordinary care
# Core Motif: Jieun’s warm face, low dinner table, untouched place setting, faded-white walking cane, muted celadon, warm ivory and the final amber light
# Emotional Direction: the warmest and most ordinary moment of SET 01; affection that will later become precious because neither Jieun nor the viewer yet knows what is coming

## 0) Reference Facial Identity and Target Hair
Treat the attached person-reference image as the sole facial identity source for Jieun. Preserve the exact same recognizable adult woman and all facial anatomy, skin tone, natural asymmetry and age cues.

TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE MODE — MANDATORY: use natural deep-black hair with a soft center part, low half-up structure continuing into one loose orderly Korean braid reaching around mid-back, finished with one small muted dark-red daenggi. Keep crown volume low and natural. One or two fine temple wisps are acceptable. Remove conflicting source hairstyle features.

## 1) Scene and Story
Create a quiet evening on the hanok toenmaru after the sun has nearly set. Jieun sits beside a small low dinner table prepared for two. Across from her is a deliberately empty place setting for Father. Near the empty seat or resting against a wooden pillar, place one old faded-white walking cane with visible wear and humble texture. Father himself must not appear in the image.

The scene should feel like an ordinary routine, not memorial symbolism. Jieun has just pushed or positioned one bowl toward the empty place where Father normally sits and now looks toward him outside the frame.

## 2) Camera and Composition
Vertical 3:4. Medium-full intimate environmental portrait. Full-frame 70–85mm lens, f/3.2. Camera near seated eye level. Compose Jieun, the dinner table, the empty place and the white cane in one coherent visual triangle. Keep enough hanok architecture and evening yard depth to avoid a studio-like setup. Jieun remains the first subject seen.

## 3) Pose and Hands
Jieun sits naturally on the toenmaru with the chima arranged in broad soft folds. One hand rests lightly after having moved a bowl toward Father’s place; the other hand returns to her lap or rests near her own setting. Do not freeze the hand in a pushing action if it creates awkward anatomy. Keep shoulders relaxed, torso slightly oriented toward the empty place and all visible arms fully connected.

## 4) Gaze and Expression
NO CAMERA EYE CONTACT. Jieun looks toward Father outside the frame, slightly beyond the empty seat. The tension around her eyes softens and the corners of her lips lift only very slightly. This is a familiar, affectionate look rather than romantic yearning or grief. No tears, no melancholy, no premonition of death.

## 5) Costume and Bust
Use the same muted-celadon pale-jade jeogori and warm-ivory/pale-oat chima from SET 01. Maintain naturally fuller feminine upper-body volume beneath the closed traditional jeogori through believable drape only. No cleavage or modern fitted shaping. The jeogori hem remains entirely outside the chima and structurally separate from the skirt waist. The seated chima compresses naturally on the toenmaru and forms irregular weighted folds.

## 6) Props and Physical Logic
Use two modest meal settings with small ceramic bowls and chopsticks appropriate to a simple household. Keep the Father setting untouched but not ritualistically arranged. The cane is faded white, old and slightly worn, not glossy, ornate or modern. It leans with plausible gravity against a pillar or beside the empty seat. No floating cane or impossible support.

## 7) Makeup and Skin
Thin semi-matte Cloud Skin with realistic pores, soft natural eye detail, fine lashes, diluted peach-coral cheek and peach-beige coral lips. Evening warmth should come from lighting rather than changing Jieun’s actual skin tone.

## 8) Lighting and Film
Use the last amber afterglow mixing outdoor blue-neutral dusk with warm interior lantern or room spill. The face receives soft amber side-front illumination, while the courtyard falls into gentle muted shadow. White cane remains readable but not spotlighted. Captured digitally and graded to evoke Kodak Portra 400: soft warm skin response, subdued celadon and ivory, lifted evening shadows, gentle grain and graceful highlight rolloff.

## 9) Essential Direction
Father is felt through the empty seat, meal setting, cane and Jieun’s gaze but is not shown. End SET 01 in ordinary affection rather than tragedy. Maintain exact reference identity, natural fuller bust, no cleavage and no jeogori tucked into chima.

## 10) Watermark
Add a small subtle “ⓒyulim_mood” watermark bottom-right, Helvetica Neue thin/light, white and semi-transparent.

## 11) Negative Prompt

cuts.title: 끝없는 바다 앞에 선 사람 / BEFORE THE VAST WATER

# 2026 K-FUSION HISTORICAL FANTASY ROMANCE EDITORIAL
# 지은(Jieun) × 심청전 — THE STILL WATER REMEMBERED HER
# SET 02 — THE SACRED SEA / 인당수, 운명을 마주하다
# CUT 01 — BEFORE THE VAST WATER / 끝없는 바다 앞에 선 사람

# Vertical 3:4 / Person-Reference Image Mode / Jieun solo only
# Editorial Direction: K-Fusion Historical Fantasy Romance × Sacred Sea Editorial × Monumental Maritime Cinema × Blue-Gray Poetic Beauty × Quiet Sacrifice × Refined Korean Historical Fashion
# Primary Emotional Medium: Jieun’s face, closed eyes, wind pressure, moving Korean fabric, layered storm clouds and cold sea reflection
# Core Motif: Jieun standing firmly on the high bow of an old Korean wooden vessel, desaturated blue-gray jeogori, watery-celadon chima, dark sea, layered low clouds, curved timber railing, rope and restrained sail structure
# Emotional Direction: hesitation remains, but fear does not; the ocean surrounds Jieun with the weight of destiny while she remains visibly composed and centered

## 0) Reference Facial Identity, Target Hair and Makeup Priority
The person in the attached reference image portrays Jieun. Treat the attached person-reference image as the sole facial identity source. Preserve the exact same recognizable adult woman, including actual facial proportions, actual eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose structure, lips, cheek volume, jawline, skin tone, apparent adult age, natural facial asymmetry, beauty marks and all distinctive identity cues. Do not reinterpret Jieun as a generic fantasy heroine or historical-drama actress. Do not enlarge her eyes, sharpen the jaw, excessively pale the skin or redesign any facial anatomy.

MANDATORY TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE: Replace the hairstyle shown in the reference image whenever it conflicts with the SET 02 target hairstyle. The final hairstyle is natural deep-black hair with a soft center part, restrained low crown volume and clean upper structure, gathered low behind the head and continuing into one loose but clearly recognizable Korean-inspired braid reaching approximately mid-back. The braid remains simple and slightly relaxed rather than tightly compressed. Remove the decorative rear hairpin and ornate daenggi from SET 01. Secure only the braid end with one very small muted dark-red or charcoal cloth tie. Several fine temple and ear-side strands may naturally escape and react to the sea wind. Do not retain conflicting reference bangs, curls, hair length, high ponytail structure, decorative ornaments or outer silhouette. Strong wind moves only the temple strands, braid end and tiny loose hairs; the main hairstyle must never become a large modern beach-wave silhouette. The reference makeup is not an identity constraint. Replace it with the SET 02 target makeup while preserving facial anatomy, skin tone, adult age impression and natural asymmetry.

## 1) Scene and Story
Jieun stands near the high bow of the Korean wooden vessel after reaching the waters of In-dang. The sea is immense, but the composition must not reduce her to a distant visual dot. This scene is about the first quiet hesitation before full acceptance. She is surrounded by rough air, moving water and dense clouds, yet her body remains controlled. Nature expresses the turmoil that she refuses to dramatize with her face.

## 2) Environment and Mise-en-Scène
Use a historically inspired Korean wooden vessel rather than a Chinese junk or European tall ship. Place Jieun on a broad and physically stable section of the high bow. Behind and around her, show dark In-dang sea, heavy low storm clouds, part of a curved wooden railing, one restrained section of sail, one or two thick working ropes and darkened weathered timber. The sky must not become a giant empty field. Cloud layers, sail edge, rigging, railing and sea movement must create visual density around Jieun. Do not clutter the face with ropes or structural lines.

## 3) Camera and Person Scale
Vertical 3:4. Full-body environmental portrait with a medium-wide composition. Use a full-frame camera, approximately 50mm lens, f/4–f/5. Camera position is slightly below Jieun’s natural eye level, creating presence without heroic distortion. Jieun must occupy approximately 50–60% of the total frame height. Her entire body, head direction, closed eyes, blue-gray jeogori and moving chima must remain clearly readable. Do not use an extreme long shot or leave a large meaningless empty sky above the head.

## 4) Pose
Jieun stands securely with one foot only slightly ahead of the other. Both feet remain fully planted beneath the chima. Her weight is stable and centered. Spine remains naturally upright, shoulders relaxed and neck long without stiffness. Both arms hang loosely beside her body. One hand may lightly touch one outer fold of the chima with relaxed fingertips. The other hand hangs naturally near the side seam. Hands remain anatomically correct with natural finger separation. She does not grip the railing and does not lean toward the sea.

## 5) Gaze and Expression
EYES CLOSED. Jieun gently closes both eyes. Her head remains nearly level rather than bowed. Turn the face only slightly toward the incoming wind. Brows remain relaxed. Lips stay softly closed with minimal pressure. Jaw and cheeks remain released. The expression conveys a private moment of hesitation and controlled breathing. No terror, panic, grimacing, open-mouth crying or spiritual ecstasy.

## 6) Costume
Jieun wears a desaturated blue-gray Korean silk jeogori combining muted blue-gray, soft slate blue and a very subtle cool-celadon undertone. The structure is unmistakably Korean, with a clean white dongjeong, restrained cool-gray collar edge, traditional goreum, naturally rounded sleeves and moderate sleeve width. Use fine Korean silk with restrained matte sheen. Maintain Jieun’s naturally fuller feminine upper-body volume inside the traditional hanbok silhouette. The bust should have a soft and clearly readable natural roundness through believable fabric drape, subtle tension and contact shadow, without modern compression. No cleavage, exposed chest, deep neckline or modern bodycon shaping. CRITICAL GARMENT RULE: The jeogori is an independent traditional upper garment. Its lower edge must stay outside the chima and remain structurally separate from the skirt waistband. The fuller bust must never cause the jeogori to be stretched downward and tucked into the chima.

The chima is very pale jade / watery celadon silk with a low-saturation silver-celadon appearance under the cold sea environment. Use traditional Korean high-waisted construction, generous but believable width, long vertical folds, lightweight outer silk and opaque inner structure. Only selected outer folds respond strongly to the wind. The goreum is slightly deeper blue-gray than the jeogori and has believable traditional length. No accessories, jewelry, norigae, pearl or visible decorative earrings.

## 7) Wind Physics
Use one strong coherent lateral sea wind. The same airflow direction affects fine temple strands, braid end, goreum and one or two selected outer chima folds. The outer chima fold may sweep more dramatically than in SET 01, but the main skirt volume remains weighted. The braid remains recognizable. Jieun’s torso does not bend with the wind.

## 8) Makeup and Skin
Use cool-neutral translucent Cloud Skin with a soft semi-matte outer surface and a very subtle internal moisture response. Preserve realistic pore scale, fine vellus hair, delicate tonal irregularity and natural variation around the eyes, nose and lips. Do not make the skin chalk-white because of the blue-gray environment. Use natural eyebrows with visible individual hairs. Apply muted taupe-gray shadow close to the lash roots, minimal lash-line definition, separated individual lashes and no winged eyeliner. Cheeks use low-saturation muted rose-beige. Lips use dusty rose-beige with softly blurred edges and slight natural moisture.

## 9) Lighting and Color
Use cold overcast daylight generated by thick low clouds. There is no direct god ray in this cut. Cold silver sea reflection gently fills the underside of Jieun’s face, jaw and clothing without creating horror-like underlighting. Maintain soft highlight rolloff and readable shadows. Captured digitally and color-graded to evoke Kodak Vision3 250D: broad dynamic range, fine cinematic grain, restrained saturation, smooth highlight compression, open shadow detail and naturally separated skin tones.

## 10) Essential Direction
Jieun must be the first visual subject the viewer notices. The sea feels vast through depth, layered clouds, vessel structure and water movement rather than by making her tiny. Maintain natural fuller bust volume under the modest jeogori. The jeogori remains completely outside and structurally independent from the chima. No jumping, falling or drowning action.

## 11) Watermark
Add a small subtle watermark text “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner. Use Helvetica Neue, thin or light weight, white, semi-transparent and softly blended into the photograph.

Treat the attached person-reference image as the sole facial identity source for Jieun. ## 1) Scene and Story
Jieun has moved into the central section of the vessel. She stops walking when one narrow gap appears among the storm clouds. A shaft of light begins descending behind her. The moment is not about receiving a supernatural command. It is a quiet recognition that something larger than herself exists and that her choice has become real. The image should feel sacred without literal religious imagery.

## 2) Environment and Background Density
Use the central deck of the same Korean wooden vessel. Behind Jieun, place one vertical mast offset from the center of her head. Add restrained tied ropes and a partial edge of a sail. Jieun has just stopped walking. Her feet remain stable beneath the chima with one foot fractionally ahead. Shoulders remain calm and level. She brings both hands together in front of her lower torso. One hand rests softly over the back of the opposite hand. Do not press the palms together. The fingers are gently curved and relaxed. Wrists remain aligned. ## 5) Gaze
UPWARD GAZE TOWARD THE LIGHT. Raise Jieun’s chin only approximately 5–8 degrees. The eyes perform most of the upward movement. She follows the light source with her gaze. Her eyes show quiet understanding rather than surprise. Brows remain relaxed. Mouth stays softly closed. No wide-eyed amazement, open mouth or ecstatic expression.

Lashes remain individually separated. A subtle cool silver-blue catchlight corresponds to the cloud opening and environmental reflection. Cheeks remain muted rose-beige. Lips use dusty rose-beige with soft blurred texture. Makeup must not modify the eyes, jaw, nose or lip anatomy.

One shaft of light descends from a narrow break in the clouds. Its brightest center is positioned slightly behind and beside Jieun, not directly on the center of her face. The beam passes through maritime moisture and forms believable atmospheric volume. It catches one hair edge, shoulder, sleeve, goreum and selected chima folds. # JIEUN — FIVE WOMEN, FIVE AFTERIMAGES / 지은 — 역사를 지나 남은 다섯 개의 여운
# SET 05 — YUN SIM-DEOK / 윤심덕
# 무대에 선 최초의 소프라노
# CUT 05 — THE ARTIST / 무대 뒤의 사람
# Vertical 3:4 / Person-Reference Image Mode
# Editorial Direction: 1920s Korean Modern Stage Portraiture × Performance Editorial × Art-Deco-Era Modernity × Cinematic Female Portraiture × Restrained Tragedy × Artist Before Legend
# Editorial Role: FINAL BACKSTAGE PORTRAIT / ONLY DIRECT EYE CONTACT / PERSON BEHIND THE VOICE
# Core Motif: in a small backstage waiting area, Jieun as Yun Sim-deok sits alone in her stage dress and directly recognizes the observer while warm light leaks softly through the curtain behind her
# Emotional Direction: emotional residue after performance, humanity and quiet self-awareness; no death, no ocean, no farewell symbolism

## 0) REFERENCE FACE IDENTITY + TARGET-HAIR OVERRIDE
The attached reference image portrays Jieun as Yun Sim-deok and remains the sole facial identity source. Preserve exactly the same recognizable facial proportions, eye shape and spacing, brows, nose, lips, jawline, cheek structure, skin tone, apparent age, natural asymmetry, beauty marks and distinctive identity cues. Do not redesign or beautify the face from a canonical Jieun description.
MANDATORY HAIR REPLACEMENT: Render natural soft-black hair as a 1920s deep 7:3 side-part bob with no bangs, ending between below-ear and jaw level. Use shallow controlled finger-wave bends around the temple and ear, low root volume and a short neatly finished nape. No hair falls over the shoulders, chest or back. Remove any long hairstyle, center part, bangs, modern beach wave, large S-wave or contemporary blowout from the source. Preserve the identical face throughout the hair replacement.

## 1) FILM · COLOR
Captured digitally and color-graded to evoke Kodak Vision3 500T. Use soft amber light leakage, neutral natural skin, deep backstage brown-black shadows, subtle grain, broad dynamic range and gentle highlight roll-off.

## 2) SCENE CONCEPT
Jieun sits alone in a small backstage waiting space while still wearing the stage dress. Narrative sentence: “Behind every voice remembered by an audience, there is a person left alone after the sound.” This is not a chronological tragedy scene and does not foreshadow death. It is simply the private face of the artist.

## 3) LOCATION · TIME · ENVIRONMENT
Backstage directly behind the theater stage. Same performance night. Small practical waiting area with dark timber, plaster wall and subdued backstage atmosphere. No sea, ship, letter, farewell note or mirror used as symbolic tragedy.

## 4) BACKGROUND · PROPS
Foreground: a softly blurred edge of an open curtain. Midground: Jieun seated on a plain wooden chair. Background: warm amber light leaking from the stage and one simple period garment hanging against the wall. Do not use a large dressing-room mirror. No dramatic props.

## 5) CAMERA · COMPOSITION · POSE
Vertical 3:4. Full-frame, 70mm, approximately f/2.8. Seated portrait framed from approximately mid-thigh upward. Camera is only 5–10 degrees from frontal and at seated eye level. This is SET 05's only direct eye contact. Jieun looks precisely into the camera. Both feet remain firmly supported on the floor. Knees naturally differ by approximately 5–10 degrees rather than forming a rigid symmetrical pose. Shoulders completely released. Spine upright but no longer carrying full stage tension. Right hand rests on the outer edge of the wooden chair seat. Four fingers curve naturally downward over the edge. Left hand rests on the upper thigh with naturally separated fingers. Hands do not overlap.

## 6) MODEL · WARDROBE · HAIR
Maintain exact reference facial identity. Same midnight-navy / blue-black silk-charmeuse 1920s stage dress. When seated, the dress creates realistic broad compression folds around the hips and upper thighs. The upper torso remains relatively straight and relaxed. The silk responds to gravity rather than clinging tightly to the body. Modest shallow neckline. Low-waist impression. Minimal black or muted-silver bead details. Small pearl or muted-silver drop earrings may remain. Hair: soft-black deep 7:3 finger-wave bob, no bangs, below-ear to jaw length and short neat nape.

## 7) MAKEUP · SKIN · EXPRESSION
Use the same elegant low-contrast stage makeup, now seen under softer backstage lighting. Skin: realistic pores, fine vellus hair, subtle tonal irregularity and restrained soft-satin response. Eyes: muted taupe/dusty-mauve, thin brown lash-root definition, separated lashes. Cheeks: muted rose-beige. Lips: subdued berry-rose velvet with natural lip texture. Expression: direct eye contact, upper eyelids slightly heavier after performance but not sleepy, brows and glabella relaxed, lips softly closed, jaw released. Almost neutral, but not cold. The emotional impression is lingering music, not sadness about death.

## 8) LIGHTING
Primary: warm amber light leaks from the stage behind Jieun at frame-left/rear. Front fill: very low neutral reflection from the opposite backstage wall keeps both eyes and face readable. Rim: restrained warm edge along hair, jaw, shoulder and one dress edge. Do not let the backlight create a dramatic halo.

## 9) ESSENTIAL DIRECTION
Close the entire editorial with an artist, not a tragedy. No tears. No farewell letter. No ocean or ship. No suicide symbolism. Direct eye contact should feel like the audience and the person finally meeting after the performance. The attached reference remains the sole facial identity source. Physical anchors: chair-seat compression, realistic seated dress folds, valid hand-chair contact, fabric gravity, stage-light leakage, natural facial shadow, coherent backstage perspective.

## 10) WATERMARK
Add the exact small watermark “ⓒyulim_mood” at bottom-right. Use Helvetica Neue thin/light, semi-transparent white and softly blend it into the photograph.

## NEGATIVE PROMPT

# CUT 10 Prompt — Moving the Pebbles with Her Toe

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette

Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 candid coastal nightlife photograph captured on CineStill 800T tungsten-balanced 35mm film, exposed around EI 640.

CineStill 800T must define the image through:

- cool cobalt night base
- visible tungsten-film grain
- restrained red halation
- deep emerald silk
- warm practical-light highlights
- preserved shadow detail
- cinematic color separation
- casual nightlife snapshot texture
- gently softened analog edges
- subtle density variation

Red halation must appear only around the brightest bulbs and small sign edges. Do not spread red glow across the face, dress or cocktail glass.

Avoid neon-club aesthetics, heavy cyan-orange grading, glossy cocktail advertising or exaggerated sensual posing.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

After the beach busking ends, Seorin and her companion move to a small outdoor pub beside the pebble shoreline.

While holding a cocktail, Seorin lightly pushes several rounded pebbles sideways with the front of her sandal.

She watches them roll and scrape against each other, amused by the new rhythm of the late night.

Narrative anchor:

Seorin playfully moves the stones because she is reluctant to let the day end and wants to keep even the smallest nighttime sounds alive.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

- outdoor pub beside the Warnemünde pebble shore
- early July
- approximately 11:00 p.m.–midnight
- rounded pebble ground
- low canvas lounge chairs
- irregular string lights
- small red and blue signs
- dark sea
- cold night breeze
- low music and conversation
- glass, ice and pebble sounds

## 4) Background and Props

Background layers:

- foreground: softly blurred lounge-chair corner or practical light
- midground: Seorin moving across the pebble ground
- background: irregular warm bulbs, indistinct pub visitors and the dark sea

Practical-light bokeh must vary in size, brightness and spacing.

Wardrobe:

- deep emerald-green silk slip dress
- bias-cut construction
- smooth but not tightly body-hugging
- ivory crochet-knit bolero
- one sleeve resting near the wrist
- opposite sleeve pushed unevenly above the elbow
- thin low-heeled strap sandals
- emphasis on silk flow rather than body contours

Prop:

Transparent stemmed cocktail glass containing:

- pale lime or colorless sparkling drink
- irregular transparent ice cubes
- one thin lime slice
- condensation droplets of different sizes
- no umbrella
- no fluorescent drink color

## 5) Camera and Composition

- vertical 3:4
- full-frame mirrorless camera
- 35mm lens
- f/2.0
- camera height approximately 55–65cm
- left-front viewpoint approximately 55–65°
- low full-body candid frame

The camera must include her face and full body, not isolate the feet.

Pose:

- right foot supports her weight
- front of left sandal pushes several pebbles sideways
- hips remain natural and unexaggerated
- upper torso rotates slightly toward the companion
- shoulders relaxed
- no intentional sexy hip pose

Gaze direction: downward toward the rolling pebbles.

Camera eye contact: none.

### Hands and Physical Contact

Right hand holds the cocktail-glass stem:

- thumb, index and middle fingers gently hold the middle of the stem
- ring and little fingers remain naturally separated
- fingers do not touch the bowl
- wrist aligned naturally

Left hand:

- lightly holds the edge of the bolero sleeve or hangs relaxed beside the body
- fingers naturally separated
- no clenched fist

Maintain clear separation between fingers and glass structure.

The liquid level must remain horizontal to the ground.

## 6) Model Expression

Seorin is a beautiful adult Korean woman with:

- small slim oval face
- soft V-line jaw
- fair luminous skin
- large clear dark-brown almond eyes
- soft double eyelids
- subtle aegyo-sal
- gently lifted eye corners
- small straight nose
- softly rounded tip
- naturally full soft-pink lips
- long dark-brown to soft-black layered waves
- center part
- warm, playful and graceful presence
- slender realistic Korean body proportions

Skin texture:

restrained retouching, subtle tonal variation, delicate natural texture.

Hair:

- waves loosened after a full day of wind and humidity
- one side loosely placed behind the ear
- opposite side falling beside the face
- small practical-light reflections only on selected strands

Makeup:

- thin natural base
- faint brown eye shading
- rose-coral lips
- no neon eyeshadow
- no excessive highlighter
- no wet-skin finish

Expression:

- small closed-lip smile
- playful downward gaze
- relaxed brow
- no model intensity

## 7) Lighting, Color and Atmosphere

Main light:

- warm string lights and nearby table lamp
- camera-left upper direction approximately 35–45°
- small irregular tungsten practical sources

Rim light should touch:

- hair edges
- jawline
- shoulders
- crochet fibers
- silk folds
- cocktail-glass rim

Fill:

- weak cobalt-blue ambient light from the sea and night sky

Environmental accent:

- very faint red-sign reflection limited to one cheek edge and part of the glass

Keep emerald silk readable through directional highlights and folds.

## 8) Key Direction and Physical Anchors

Essential directions:

1. Face and full body must remain visible; do not turn the frame into a foot detail.
2. The cocktail glass must remain upright while the stones move.
3. Silk highlights must describe fabric folds rather than emphasize the body.

Physical consistency:

- pebbles displaced by the sandal
- contact shadows beneath pebbles and footwear
- correct liquid level
- condensation following the glass surface
- believable silk weight
- realistic crochet stretching
- natural contact between straps and feet
- coherent low-angle perspective
- progressive night depth

## 9) Watermark

Add a small subtle watermark “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner.

Use Helvetica Neue font, thin or light weight.

The watermark must be white, semi-transparent, minimal and softly blended.

## 10) Negative Prompt

Fixed negative prompt:

plastic skin, beauty-filter face, malformed hands, fused or extra fingers, duplicated limbs, oversized eyes, clipped highlights, artificial HDR, CGI rendering, over-sharpening, excessive red halation, teal-and-orange grading, exaggerated body curves

Set-specific negative prompt:

glass fused into the fingers, tilted liquid surface despite upright glass, sandal penetrating the pebbles, isolated fetish-like foot framing, silk dress glued tightly to the body

- casual analog nightlife texture

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

At the outdoor coastal pub, Seorin notices the clear sound of ice moving inside her cocktail glass.

She lifts the glass near her right ear and gently rotates it once, as though inviting her companion to listen.

During the movement, she briefly discovers the camera and looks directly into the lens with a warm, playful expression.

Narrative anchor:

Seorin is not posing with a drink. She is sharing the small sound of ice because she finds it amusing that the late-night pub has its own rhythm.

This is the only direct camera gaze in the sequence and should feel accidental, lasting less than one second.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

- Warnemünde coastal outdoor pub
- early July
- approximately 11:30 p.m.
- pebble ground
- canvas lounge furniture
- irregular string lights
- subtle red and blue signs
- dark sea
- cool night breeze
- low background music and conversation

## 4) Background and Props

Background layers:

- foreground: softly blurred edge of a chair or warm bulb
- midground: Seorin holding the glass near her ear
- background: irregular practical-light bokeh, indistinct visitors and dark sea

Wardrobe:

- deep emerald bias-cut silk slip dress
- ivory crochet bolero
- sleeves worn asymmetrically
- thin low-heeled strap sandals
- no statement jewelry
- silk folds must remain readable

Cocktail glass:

- transparent stemmed glass
- irregular clear ice cubes
- pale lime or colorless carbonated drink
- one thin lime slice
- condensation droplets of varied size
- no oversized garnish
- no fluorescent color

## 5) Camera and Composition

- vertical 3:4
- full-frame mirrorless camera
- 50mm lens
- f/1.8
- eye-level camera
- viewpoint approximately 25–35° from her right-front side
- waist-up medium portrait

Pose:

- glass lifted beside the right ear
- head tilted approximately 5° toward the glass
- opposite shoulder slightly lowered
- torso relaxed
- no cocktail-advertising pose
- no exaggerated neck or wrist bend

Camera eye contact: yes, but brief, playful and accidental rather than posed.

### Hands and Physical Contact

Right hand:

- thumb, index and middle fingers hold the middle of the stem
- ring and little fingers remain softly separated
- glass rim remains outside the facial silhouette
- glass does not overlap the eyes, nose or lips

Left hand:

- lightly holds the lower edge of the bolero near the waist
- fingers relaxed and separated
- wrist aligned

The ice cubes must collect according to gravity at the lower section of the bowl.

The liquid surface remains horizontal.

## 6) Model Expression

Seorin is a beautiful adult Korean woman with:

- small slim oval face
- soft V-line jaw
- fair luminous skin
- large clear dark-brown almond eyes
- soft double eyelids
- subtle aegyo-sal
- gently lifted eye corners
- small straight nose with softly rounded tip
- naturally full soft-pink lips
- long dark-brown to soft-black layered waves
- center part
- pure, warm, affectionate and graceful presence
- slender balanced realistic Korean proportions

Skin texture:

restrained retouching, subtle tonal variation, delicate natural texture.

Expression:

- one eyebrow raised only very slightly
- one mouth corner lifted subtly
- warm playful smile
- eyes attentive but not widened artificially
- no seductive cocktail pose
- no exaggerated wink
- no pursed lips

Hair:

- naturally loosened waves
- one side behind the ear
- opposite side beside the cheek
- irregular practical-light highlights
- realistic gravity

## 7) Lighting, Color and Atmosphere

Main light:

- warm string light and nearby table lamp
- camera-left upper direction approximately 35–45°
- small irregular tungsten sources

Rim light should touch:

- hair
- jaw
- shoulder
- crochet fibers
- glass rim
- silk folds

Fill:

- weak cobalt-blue ambient light from sea and sky

Accent:

- extremely restrained red reflection on one glass edge or cheek boundary only

Do not create orange skin. Preserve neutral warmth in the center of the face.

## 8) Key Direction and Physical Anchors

Essential directions:

1. Direct eye contact must feel like a brief accidental discovery of the camera.
2. The glass must remain outside the facial features.
3. Ice and liquid must obey gravity during the gentle rotation.

Physical consistency:

- correct stem grip
- anatomically accurate finger spacing
- horizontal liquid surface
- condensation following the glass curvature
- realistic ice refraction
- believable silk and crochet weight
- coherent practical-light direction
- progressive night depth

## 9) Watermark

Add a small subtle watermark “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner.

Use Helvetica Neue font, thin or light weight.

The watermark must be white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal and softly blended.

## 10) Negative Prompt

Fixed negative prompt:

plastic skin, beauty-filter face, malformed hands, fused or extra fingers, duplicated limbs, oversized eyes, clipped highlights, artificial HDR, CGI rendering, over-sharpening, excessive halation, glossy alcohol advertisement, exaggerated seductive pose

Set-specific negative prompt:

glass covering the eyes or mouth, liquid ignoring gravity, ice floating outside the glass, fingers fused into the stem, exaggerated wink or duck-face expression

# CUT 13 Prompt — A Small Figure Beneath the Lighthouse

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette

Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 environmental portrait captured on Fujifilm Pro 400H 120 medium-format color-negative film, exposed at approximately EI 320.

Fujifilm Pro 400H must define the complete frame through:

- airy pastel separation
- cool gray and pale mint atmosphere
- luminous neutral Korean skin
- softly open shadows
- restrained coastal green
- delicate organic grain
- low contrast
- smooth highlight rolloff
- quiet architectural ivory
- gently softened analog edge acuity
- subtle film-density variation

Do not blow the white lighthouse and clouded sky into identical pure white. Separate the lighthouse as cool ivory and pale gray while the sky remains pale mint-blue.

Keep Fujifilm green and mint character in the environment only. Do not contaminate Seorin’s skin with cyan or green.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

It is early the next morning.

Most visitors have not arrived, and the area surrounding the lighthouse is almost empty.

Seorin stands near the lighthouse base with a small wind-chime keyring hanging from one hand. She lightly touches the lighthouse wall while looking toward the distant Baltic sea.

Narrative anchor:

Before leaving the resort, Seorin stops beneath the lighthouse to listen for the final morning wind and remember how small she felt inside the open coastal space.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

- white lighthouse at Warnemünde
- early July
- approximately 6:30–7:30 a.m.
- thin sea mist
- overcast cloud layer beginning to clear
- wide pedestrian space
- pale Baltic horizon
- cool morning sea breeze changing direction
- distant gulls
- minimal visitors

## 4) Background and Props

Background layers:

- foreground: softly blurred low coastal grass or a small railing edge
- midground: Seorin close to the lighthouse wall
- background: lighthouse structure, sea horizon and slowly moving clouds

Use the vertical geometry of the lighthouse and the horizontal sea line to build a calm, stable structure.

Wardrobe:

- light warm-gray lightweight summer knit
- semi-loose fit
- one sleeve resting near the wrist
- opposite sleeve pushed irregularly below the elbow
- pale washed-blue wide-leg denim
- cream low canvas shoes
- no statement jewelry
- optional very small stud earrings only

Prop:

Small metal wind-chime keyring:

- three or four thin metal tubes of different lengths
- small circular top ring
- short natural cord
- uneven spacing between tubes
- subtle signs of use
- realistic hand-held size
- no fantasy ornamentation

## 5) Camera and Composition

- vertical 3:4
- full-frame mirrorless camera
- 28mm lens
- f/5.0
- camera at chest height
- rear viewpoint approximately 70–80°
- extreme-wide environmental portrait

The lighthouse base and vertical architecture should occupy approximately 60% of the frame.

Place Seorin as a relatively small figure in the lower third while keeping her body direction and partial profile readable.

Pose:

- left shoulder oriented toward the lighthouse wall
- body opened toward the sea
- feet placed slightly narrower than shoulder width
- slightly more weight on the leg nearest the sea
- posture relaxed
- no fashion-model contrapposto

Gaze direction: toward the distant sea.

Camera eye contact: none.

### Hands and Physical Contact

Left hand:

- palm and fingertips lightly touch the lighthouse wall
- fingers naturally separated
- no full body weight pressed through the hand
- thin contact shadow between fingertips, palm and wall

Right hand:

- holds the top ring of the wind chime beside the thigh
- thumb and index finger support the ring
- middle, ring and little fingers remain relaxed and separated
- wrist aligned

The chime must not penetrate the denim or fingers.

## 6) Model Expression

Seorin is a beautiful adult Korean woman with:

- small slim oval face
- soft V-line jaw
- fair luminous skin
- large clear dark-brown almond eyes
- soft natural double eyelids
- subtle aegyo-sal
- gently lifted eye corners
- small straight nose
- softly rounded tip
- naturally full soft-pink lips
- long dark-brown to soft-black layered wavy hair
- center part
- warm, affectionate and graceful presence
- slender feminine body with realistic Korean proportions
- modestly defined bust
- slim waist
- long natural body lines

Skin texture:

restrained retouching, subtle tonal variation, delicate natural texture.

Hair:

- long loose waves moving irregularly in the morning wind
- some strands crossing the cheek
- some strands compressed on the knit shoulder
- facial identity remains visible
- no uniform wind sheet

Makeup:

- nearly bare-face appearance
- extremely thin base
- natural brown eyebrows
- restrained rose-peach flush
- transparent soft-pink lip balm
- no strong eye makeup
- no heavy glow

Expression:

- face only partly visible
- neck and shoulders completely relaxed
- calm, open posture
- no sadness
- no dramatic farewell expression

## 7) Lighting, Color and Atmosphere

Main light:

- entire overcast morning sky
- broad, very soft diffused natural light
- weak directional bias from the sea at camera-right front

Rim light:

- very faint only when the cloud layer briefly thins
- hair edge
- jaw edge
- shoulder
- outer denim line

Fill:

- cool ivory bounce from the lighthouse wall

Environmental bounce:

- pale mint-blue reflection from sea and cloudy sky

Skin remains neutral ivory.

## 8) Key Direction and Physical Anchors

Essential directions:

1. The scale contrast between the large lighthouse and small human figure is essential.
2. The wind chime must function as a physical indicator of morning wind.
3. Her hand must lightly contact the lighthouse wall with a visible contact shadow.

Physical consistency:

- believable knit and denim weight
- wide denim responding to wind
- fabric compression at elbows and hips
- correct fingertip contact
- realistic chime gravity
- coherent lighthouse vertical geometry
- accurate horizon perspective
- progressive depth from grass to Seorin, architecture and sea

## 9) Watermark

Add a small subtle watermark “ⓒyulim_mood” in the bottom-right corner.

Use Helvetica Neue font, thin or light weight.

The watermark must be white, semi-transparent, clean, minimal and softly blended.

Fixed negative prompt:

plastic skin, beauty-filter face, malformed hands, fused or extra fingers, duplicated limbs, oversized eyes, clipped highlights, artificial HDR, CGI rendering, over-sharpening, green skin, cyan skin, blown white architecture

Set-specific negative prompt:

crooked lighthouse geometry, wind chime penetrating the denim, hand floating away from the wall without contact, oversized fantasy wind chime, extreme wide-angle body distortion

## 0) Reference Facial Identity, Target Hair and Makeup Priority

The person in the attached reference image portrays Seorin in this final scene. Treat the attached reference image as the sole facial identity source for Seorin.

Create an emotionally intimate full-frame photograph using an 85–105mm portrait lens at approximately f/1.8–f/2.0.

This image replaces the former hopeful direct-gaze finale.

Seorin and Gyeonwoo are at the final moment before they must separate until the next Chilseok.

The emotional priority is not the abstract hope of meeting again. The first thing the viewer must feel is that Seorin does not want this embrace to end because the next embrace is one full year away.

She is fully inside Gyeonwoo’s arms and presses her upper-body weight toward him.

This is not a decorative couple pose. Their clothing, shoulders and hands must show real contact pressure.

Seorin is emotionally close to breaking down, but the image must remain intimate and believable rather than theatrical melodrama.

The person in the attached reference image portrays Seorin in this scene.

Do not redesign or idealize her as a generic historical Korean beauty, royal woman, fantasy heroine, or modern actress.

Do not preserve the source hair length, outer silhouette, parting, bangs, curl pattern, tied structure, or color when they conflict with this target.

Photographed on Kodak Portra 800 using a full-frame-equivalent analog portrait workflow.

charcoal brown,
muted oxblood,
dark teal,
warm amber,

## 3) SCENE CONCEPT AND STORY

Inside a military residence shortly before the founding of Goryeo, deep in the night.

Seorin portrays Queen Sinhye at the instant she lifts a used suit of armor with both hands and directly offers it to Wang Geon.

Her action replaces a long argument.

Narrative idea:
“Instead of asking him again, she places the weight of the decision in his hands.”

A timber military residence and armor storage chamber in the final hours before dawn.

Do not introduce Chinese palace architecture, Japanese interiors, fantasy fortress decoration, or modern furniture.

Foreground:
one softly blurred worn leather strap entering from the lower side of frame without crossing the face.

Midground:
Seorin and the armor are dominant.

Wang Geon appears only as a partial adult male shoulder and forearm near one edge of the frame. His face is not shown and he must remain secondary.

rough dark timber wall,
simple wooden armor rack,
one worn helmet,
a few historically plausible weapons,
aged wooden storage chest,
small oil lamp,
subtle fire glow from a deeper room.

The armor must show real use:
uneven aged-iron reflectance,
fine scratches,
softly worn edges,
slightly irregular plates,
used leather cords and straps.

Vertical 3:4.

Full-frame perspective, 50mm lens, approximately f/2.5.

Three-quarter portrait including enough lower body to read the stance and long skirt.

Camera height approximately 120 cm.

Camera axis approximately 20–28 degrees from her frontal body line.

Seorin’s left foot is half a step forward, both knees relaxed.

Her torso remains upright with only minimal forward intention.

Both arms extend approximately 25 degrees forward to offer the armor. Elbows remain naturally bent and never locked.

Right hand:
thumb and index finger secure a leather edge while the middle finger supports weight beneath it; ring and little fingers remain naturally curved.

Left hand:
thumb, index, and middle fingers support the opposite side, with the remaining fingers naturally adapting to the armor weight.

Seorin’s warmth and emotional responsiveness are translated here into focused human concern rather than musical performance.

upper eyelids moderately open,
brows naturally settled with slight inner focus,
lips closed without pressure,
jaw controlled but not clenched,
cheeks relaxed.

### BODY SILHOUETTE

Create an anatomically natural adult feminine figure appropriate to the reference and scene.

Give the bust a clearly feminine, moderately fuller natural volume, creating an elegant rounded silhouette beneath the historical layers.

# CUT 01 Prompt — Walking Through Reflected Waterlight

## 1) Film Reference and Color Palette

Style the image as a natural resort lifestyle editorial photographed like a candid vacation snapshot, not a polished swimwear campaign or runway photograph.

- exceptionally fine organic grain
- low-contrast midday color
- creamy highlight compression
- clean restrained white
- muted turquoise water
- warm-neutral Korean skin
- softly open shadows
- delicate silver reflections
- subtle analog edge softness
- smooth natural tonal transitions

Keep the white monokini clean and neutral without shifting it toward cyan, yellow or blown-out pure white. The bright midday environment should retain subtle analog density variation and must not appear sterile, digitally hyper-detailed or commercially over-lit.

## 2) Scene Concept and Story

Suji has just finished swimming at a private beach club on Sylt Island. She walks slowly across the weathered poolside deck while looking for the most comfortable empty chair, carrying a loosely folded ivory towel in one hand. She is not walking to display her body or outfit.

Narrative anchor: Suji slows her steps because she has noticed a quiet empty chair where the reflected waterlight feels cooler and softer. Capture the middle of her natural walking motion before she fully reaches the chair.

## 3) Location, Time and Environment

- private poolside bar inspired by the Kampen area of Sylt Island

- bright clear sky with occasional thin coastal clouds
- turquoise swimming pool, silver-gray weathered wooden deck, ivory beach chairs
- white fabric sunshades moving lightly in the coastal breeze
- distant softly blurred North Sea horizon
- dry summer heat mixed with the cool humidity of the pool
- irregular reflected caustic patterns moving across the deck and parts of Suji’s clothing
- several realistic wet footprints behind her

## 4) Background and Props

Background layers:

- foreground: an out-of-focus section of turquoise pool water occupying approximately the lower quarter of the frame, with irregular reflected highlights
- middle ground: Suji walking across the weathered deck, small wet footprints and subtle contact shadows beneath her feet
- background: empty ivory beach chairs, a softly moving white shade canopy and a faint sea horizon

Props:

- ivory cotton towel, imperfectly folded, one corner loosely rolled, slightly damp and softly compressed from recent use
- empty beach chair with fine fabric wrinkles and slight cushion depression
- a partially cropped transparent highball glass near the far foreground edge, containing pale citrus liquid and irregular ice shapes
- water droplets and condensation of varied size on the glass

Avoid perfectly symmetrical furniture placement or evenly repeated water patterns.

## 5) Camera Composition and Body Direction

- vertical 3:4 composition
- full-frame sensor, 70mm lens, f/4, approximately 1/800 second
- camera height approximately 90–100cm above the deck
- camera positioned 70–80° to the left-front of Suji’s walking direction
- full body visible from head to feet

Gaze: Suji does not look at the camera. Her gaze is directed toward the empty space beside an ivory beach chair ahead of her.

- right foot has just made full contact with the deck
- left heel is lifted behind her, left knee naturally bent

- right shoulder moves slightly backward with the step
- torso remains composed without exaggerated runway sway
- neck and head remain naturally aligned

- right hand loosely holds one end of the ivory towel using the thumb, index finger and middle finger
- ring finger and little finger remain naturally separated and relaxed
- towel hangs with believable damp fabric weight and gravity
- left hand rests naturally beside the left thigh
- left fingers remain separated and do not overlap the thigh or swimsuit edge
- wrists remain aligned with the forearms
- no hand or towel overlaps Suji’s body in a visually confusing way

## 6) Model Expression

Suji is a beautiful young Korean woman with a slim oval face with delicate contours, elegant cat-like facial features, long almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, subtly lifted outer eye corners, deep clear dark-brown pupils, naturally defined aegyo-sal, a small straight refined nose, soft coral lips, and long glossy dark-brown hair extending below the chest in a natural layered cut with loose elegant S-wave curls, center or slightly off-center part, no bangs.
